title: Paris dream turns to nightmare as rooftop dwellers bake in historic heatwave
summary: The unrelenting heatwave pummeling France has turned the iconic zinc roofs of Paris into a nightmare and a health hazard for people living directly underneath in often cramped attic dwellings that retain the searing heat and are impossible to ventilate.
